mentions.name: Event-sourced coding agent
mentions.description: An AI coding agent that reportedly outperforms Claude Code on SWE-bench Verified (8/15 vs 5/15) at about half the cost per instance (~$0.06 vs ~$0.12). It is built as an event-sourced reducer with no framework dependencies beyond the Anthropic SDK, though results come from a small sample on a single repo.
mentions.problem: Existing AI coding agents like Claude Code are expensive; this project aims to beat them on benchmark performance at roughly half the cost per instance.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Coding agent that seems to beat Claude Code on SWE-bench at half the cost.

8/15 on SWE-bench Verified vs Claude Code's 5/15, ~$0.06/instance vs ~$0.12. Small sample, single repo, lots of caveats. But the direction feels right.
Event-sourced reducer, no framework deps beyond the Anthropic SDK.
